mission.title: Tightening the Circle
mission.description: Get a tracking bug from Dr. Zappa and plant it on the Effectuator.

phase.briefing:
Our scientists have been working on a little project. We now have a bug capable of locking down the Effectuator's RSI, and triangulating the location of what you might term his physical body. In fact, he possesses no physical body, but the explanation would most likely be beyond your comprehension.
Proceed to Dr. Zappa and obtain the bug from him.

enter.say: Dr. Zappa is somewhere in this building.

objective.text: Get the bug from Dr. Zappa

talk.say: Your reputation for punctuality precedes you, {player}. I have the bug for you here.

done.say: Bug in hand; you can head on over to good old Effy now.

phase.briefing: Proceed to the location indicated. Place the bug on the Effectuator's person.

enter.say: This place looks kind of empty.

done.say: Nothing. You can head out of there.

phase.briefing: Do not be discouraged. We will track down the Effectuator, and apprehend him. There is a high probability that he will be at the next location.

enter.say: Okay, I'm reading some signals this time. Looks like a party going on in there! Time to go to work.

done.say: His signal's just through there. Aw, crap... those fluctuations are starting to power up. Get through the far door!

objective.text: Plant the bug on the Effectuator

done.say: This is insane! How can we plant a bug on someone who vanishes before we get there?

mission.finish: New strategies seem to be required. We will be in contact, {player}.
